source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1934, p. 7 ("Lady loses Larne contest")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: figures and names from the printed report; vote totals recomputed where a contest is complete.

note: Election of the Larne Town Council, polled Monday 15 January 1934 (Irish News, 16 January 1934, p. 5). Only contest in Curran Ward; majority 155, 55 per cent of the 720 electors voted. Re-cited and image-checked (meetings corroboration, 7 Nov 2026): the result is on p. 7, not p. 5 (Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1934); Robinson 348 (not 346), majority 155, 'Miss Sarah E. Morrow' (Larne Times, 20 January 1934, p. 5, image-read: 348 and 193). W. Crawford was declared elected on the retirement of Mr. S. M'Meekin.
